race.description: Mclardy Mcshane Insurance Swan Hill Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: HABITUAL (7) has the strongest recent excuse profile: he was favourite when sixth at Kyneton after knuckling at the start, racing wide and being bumped, and his prior fourth at this track also came with early trouble and a held-up passage. Can atone. SWITCH HIT (5) is the reliable danger, bringing three wins at this distance and consecutive Kilmore seconds, though he rises from BM56 and was safely held as favourite last start. Each way. HIS FINEST HOUR (1) drops from BM66 and BM74 form and was beaten just under two lengths as favourite at Ballarat, he'll be running on from the wide gate. GREAT PROSPERITY (4) has been a model of consistency lately and should take holding out again.
